title: Lowmoor Festival volunteer rota check
brief: I'm the volunteer coordinator for the Lowmoor Food Festival and I need a page for my laptop at the planning desk where I can edit the Saturday 2026-11-14 rota and see at once where it breaks our rules, then copy the final rota to paste into the volunteers' group message. The rules: nobody works more than 6 hours in the day, nobody can be in two places at the same time, and the Gate needs at least 2 people from 09:00 to 17:00. The current rota, as shift, place, volunteer, start and end: S1, Gate, Priya Raman, 09:00, 13:00; S2, Gate, Marcus Oduya, 09:00, 13:00; S3, Gate, Priya Raman, 13:00, 17:00; S4, Gate, Dana Whitlock, 13:00, 17:00; S5, Info desk, Marcus Oduya, 11:00, 15:00; S6, Info desk, Tom Beresford, 09:00, 11:00; S7, Kitchen, Dana Whitlock, 08:00, 12:00. Let me change the volunteer and the times of any shift. Under "Shifts" show the editable table. Under "Conflicts" list each broken rule in words, highlighted: right now Priya, Marcus and Dana each have 8 hours, and Marcus is double-booked on the Gate and the Info desk from 11:00 to 13:00. Under "Hours per volunteer" show each person's total hours next to the limit, written as "limit of 6 hours". Under "Rota to paste" give the final rota as plain lines, one per shift, ready to copy.

edit.request: Change the daily limit from 6 hours to 8 hours, and give shift S5 to Tom Beresford instead of Marcus Oduya.
